## WORK-KDESC

**Find a descent receiver beyond the failed quadratic gauge**

**Disposition:** archived-programme. **Kind:** research. **Compute class:** none.

**Next step:** Focus on descent of the remaining Galois-permuted COMPLETE-type P1 rulings, or exclude their actual whole-factor realization by a new argument. UAAFFDESC1 now PROVES that every geometric AFFINE-type ruling of a proper native intermediate is unique and descends, with an explicit rational-point-centered weighted Galois trace and a volume-defined locally nilpotent derivation. UAMLFACTOR1 closes trivial geometric ML by published classification plus the retained period obstruction. The affine-type non-descent escape is closed; a proper native intermediate with such a ruling would disprove JC(2) through UAARITHRULING1. Conditional on JC(2), only geometrically ADDITIVELY RIGID intermediates with COMPLETE-type Galois-permuted rulings remain. Identify those conjugate fibrations or rule out their actual realization. Arbitrary trace or norm averaging is not a proof: the explicit trace of centered conjugate coordinates has generic fibre Gm, and zero Picard norm only trivializes a tensor product. Do not accumulate conditions that restate this difficulty or reopen increasing-degree coefficient searches. OP-KDESC still requires the whole canonical complete Spec(A), whole-source landing, nonlinear integration, effective gluing and absolute stable atomicity; no solution is asserted.

**Completion evidence:** The remaining atomic canonical receiver is constructed with exact complete fibre and effective polynomial gluing, or a scoped obstruction closes that stronger requirement. The earlier non-atomic polynomial-bundle existence gate is completed by UACANFIB1; it is not an outstanding task.

**Prerequisites and boundary:** Read the higher-return proof and the retained canonical trace receiver. Distinguish the all-rank common kernel from a classification of all higher-rank determinant solutions; basic descent means an actual polynomial expression in C[Z,t]. Time Keller-map invertibility contains JC(r) and is not needed for the proved factorization. Apply recent nilpotent-map results only to ordinary time Jacobians with their actual hypotheses; do not apply a total-degree-four theorem to a generic covering-degree-four profile. The nonzero signal leaf is the hyperbola complement, not affine plane. Marked deformation identities preserve entire scheme fibres because the first output is retained; mere vanishing at listed source points does not exclude hidden fibres. Canonical source-parameter families still have actual factors and no improved minima. One-direction auxiliary exceptions retain the all-inactive/non-locally-nilpotent constant-ring boundary. Generic degree and arithmetic/absolute atomicity remain distinct. Read the root-feedback proof: its graph records effective polynomial dependence on X_j after collection, not a coefficient-list graph. An edge i->j requires processing i before j. Distinguish a displayed atomic chain and supplied order-ideal models from a classification of all chains/intermediate fields. The classical principal-minor lemma is credited to the literature; its compiler application and normal form need independent proof and novelty review. The canonical trace receiver changes an auxiliary first output and is outside the new theorem. Read the scalar-self-feedback proof: the actual response contains B*g and its value at g=0 is insufficient. Its whole-map version allows rational controls but classifies EFFECTIVE profiles. The Laurent exceptions have an uncancelled B-output source pole. Every nilpotent parameter order and the formal completion can be Keller with the exact marked restrictions while no finite polynomial family in that scalar line integrates the tangent. This is not an obstruction to all multi-direction integration and gives no new canonical atomicity. Read the feedback-normal-form proof. Native indices4 and5 are coefficient-channel indices, not total coordinate or generic covering degrees. The effective pair is unique even over nonreduced bases with2 invertible. Wronskian rigidity requires affine r and source jets in a one-block map with retained identities. The signal-field normalizer hypothesis is sigma composed F in k(sigma), not first output equal sigma; vertical Keller maps are not assumed invertible. Classical formal etaleness supplies unique source coordinates at every nilpotent order but no uniform degree bound, and this creates no new formal equivalence class. Unrestricted stable inequivalence remains unproved. Read the native-orbits proof. The exact global profile orbit is the target shear ideal (a^5*c^3), with unique retained profile. Native polynomial-module membership is stronger than x-order jets; the quadratic target c^2 shear is the boundary control. The stable classification fixes identity parameters and requires source normalization of the individual signal field. Degree reduction is finite and unbounded in source-coefficient degree, but its non-dividing survivors and negative Laurent sectors are not classified. Cubic field dimension3 is an exact descent computation, not a coordinate-degree or covering-degree bound on candidates. Failure of old-K descent is not full atomicity. The scalar tangent escapes this orbit but has no constructed finite polynomial integration. Read the plane-completion proof and its explicit published imports. HC4MYGL0 applies to the generic Keller target FACTOR fixing an entire line, not to the completed map with Jacobian 1-SY. Abhyankar--Moh rectification is an imported theorem; no JC(2) hypothesis is used. The generic coordinate ring is K0[S,Y,(1-SY)^(-1)], and absence of negative r powers gives polynomial extension by 1=r+SY. The original source is the OPEN leaf and whole-source landing at sigma=0 is separate. Every polynomial-r completion is plane-indecomposable, but the full Keller map may have intermediate boundary poles, moving signals or stabilization mixing. Ordinary irreducibility suffices over one field; geometric irreducibility supplies the absolute statement. The previously conditional nontrivial native target factor after a retained profile is empty. Trushin Proposition3.1.1 already publicly contains the saturation overlap under a weaker hypothesis; compiler-application novelty remains unverified. Read the intermediate-surfaces proof. Plane cancellation is applied to the generic TARGET stage after rectifying the carried polynomial curve, not to an arbitrary higher-dimensional Keller map. It requires no nonnegative-r or plane-extension hypothesis; the old signal-retaining boundary-pole route is now CLOSED. For arbitrary factors q=(E_u,E_sigma) need not be a coordinate tuple, but q is smooth and has two-dimensional generic fibre. Geometric generic A2 alone inverts E, without a plane-form or global bundle-triviality theorem. A proper intermediate must be non-plane and satisfy both localized saturation identities; both arrows may miss only finitely many target points. The source U itself with G identity is an allowed endpoint, not a proper factor. Generic self-maps of U of every degree are etale but have canonical whole-lift poles and volume ratio d*r^(2d-2); arbitrary abstract surface isomorphisms do not settle factor degrees. Multi-block canonical atomicity and whole nonlinear integration remain open. Read the unit-rigidity proof and its explicit published root-closed inputs. The surface map preserves a PRIMITIVE unit; generic J_d examples have index d and cannot satisfy whole power descent. The deck action extends to and fixes the actual node, so omitting it loses the contradiction. The unit criterion covers every whole (u,sigma,B,C) Keller map, without native jets; the non-plane conclusion still needs the embedded-curve witness. A geometric unit descends by a scalar norm with nonzero split-unit exponent. For a proper source prefix all constant-level fibres of E_sigma on whole intermediate affine space are geometrically irreducible, but this does not classify all special fibres after fixing E_u. Localization gives a UFD over k(u,a) only; geometric divisor classes and proper unit-free non-plane surfaces remain open. A chain has one irreversible unit loss and no proven bound on the later unit-free stages. Canonical multi-block atomicity and finite nonlinear integration remain unconstructed. Read the log-picard proof: the source SNC completion is a conic plus infinity line with K+D=0; its log volume differs from the actual Keller volume by r^2. Pullback is proved for NONFINITE maps by boundary resolution, not by importing finite torus domination. The explicitly imported Miyanishi criterion combines geometric factoriality, constant units and negative log dimension; arithmetic UFD alone never implies geometric factoriality. The retained-base polynomial section normalizes line-bundle descent and forces ZERO invariant geometric Picard classes; the remaining NONZERO group need not have a proved rank or torsion classification. Ordinary Danielewski volume has a nonzero compact period. Higher-power exact regular primitives do not supply B*dC, and u has no mate. Both arrows, source landing, exact field and complete marked global gluing remain distinct obligations. Independent proof and novelty review are unverified. Actual retained-base q is a subtuple of a whole Keller map and hence smooth everywhere; the raw Danielewski polynomial spread fails this at a=0, even after identities and polynomial coordinate changes. Read the plane-charts proof and the Dubouloz2004 atlas/2009 JC(2) precedent. Any invertible plane-chart restriction supplies an open-and-closed section and collapses the entire target. The native curve condition concerns its WHOLE closed image, not a punctured restriction. Formal etaleness standardizes all curve neighborhoods without producing a global A2 chart. The root-contact lower bound is all-degree; its sharp beta-integral controls fail injectivity globally for every exponent, and no classification of other embedded curves is assumed. Nondividing ruling degrees are necessary, not sufficient; compatible chart Keller pairs would actually disprove JC(2). Read ruling-descent PROOF: Pic(base) injects by generic-fibre units; vertical prime functions then lie in K0[phi], forcing integral arithmetic fibres and reduced geometric fibres. The plane atlas uses explicitly imported classical A1-fibration facts. Dubouloz-Kishimoto gives finite-extension ruling existence, not automatic descent. Product source topology is conditional on the ACTUAL geometric fibre. Missing source divisors differ from finitely many missed target points. Sheet loss is pointwise nonnegative but its Euler integral need not be. The orbifold quotient requires surjectivity and connected generic fibre; two doubles force an even subgroup index dividing the whole source degree. Dubouloz-Kishimoto Section1.3.1/Proposition4 is an imported positive descent criterion; unique or Galois-invariant rulings do not remain an unproved descent case. Read affine-descent PROOF: distinguish the proved AFFINE-type uniqueness/descent theorem from the open COMPLETE-type orbit. The Hamiltonian derivation is locally nilpotent because the generic fibre is A1; etale lifting alone does not prove completeness. The field extension is used only for descent, not to transport the arithmetic UFD.

## WORK-KCOMP

**Make a complexity obstruction independent of the compiler**

**Disposition:** archived-programme. **Kind:** research. **Compute class:** none.

**Next step:** Seek a genuinely different affine completion or prove the source geometry for a nonlinear coefficient section, especially for characteristic-zero low-rank universality or negative binary cases. UABLEVEL1 closes every moving target-coordinate level for the independent atlas in characteristic zero. Do not recreate that source gate, the global coarse quotient, or the UAMODBOUND1 boundary escape. UAFROB1 completes the modular cubic minimum only; all characteristic-zero dimension questions retain their stated scope. Any fixed universal symmetric map in odd characteristic must remain nonproper by UAFINITE1, and its field-versal finite chart must omit a divisor. Seek a nonfinite completion rather than a globally finite repair. UAFROBCOST1 separates the solved structured modular minima from the remaining unmarked characteristic-zero minima. The cyclic-affine framed minima with full F_q constants are settled by UAAFFSUB1; UASUBDEFORM1 removes the unnecessary full-field assumption for actual line models. Returning to the remaining characteristic-zero unmarked minima needs new geometry; neither one-parameter generic polynomials nor canonical marked dimension costs supply a matching smaller Keller map. For finite bases use the full source-point budget before designing an affine realization; the new S4/F2 and S7/F2 bounds still need matching constructions or stronger obstructions. The finite-base quartic gap is now 3<=ktdim_F2(S4)<=4: a four-coordinate finite atomic map is constructed. A three-coordinate realization or a stronger global obstruction would close it. The remaining characteristic-zero problems still require new affine geometry. Any natural cyclic-affine completion with nontrivial complement must permit the rank-one ramified boundary forced by UAINERTIACOST1. UASCALARDIM1 settles scalar-affine fixed framed minima over divisible-degree finite bases. For r>1 with f not dividing e, deciding between r=ceil(e/f) and r+1 requires a map without a retained coordinate or a new unrestricted obstruction.

**Completion evidence:** A universal lower bound, with a matching realization if an exact minimum is claimed.

**Prerequisites and boundary:** UADOUBLE1 gives the exact smooth trace-isotropy criterion and symmetric monodromy. UABINARY1 is necessary and sufficient for this compiler when N is invertible; the modular nonconstant-vector condition is sufficient. Fixed-field quadratic isotropy does not imply universality over all extensions. UAK7MIN1 consumes Duncan essential dimension, while UADOUBLEMOD1 leaves stable-class choices even at minimal target dimension. UARECV1 supplies lower-dimensional receivers without affine-space conclusions. UAQFAIL1 proves global coarse contraction, UACTARGET1 proves source unit obstructions, and UAPROFILE1 supplies the exact all-degree landing rule. These do not alter the already proved rank-seven minimum on its specified bases or give new global lower bounds. UAMODBOUND1 gives complete exceptional modular boundary fibres and excludes degree-N field realization there; UAALLATOM1 settles profile monodromy and atomicity independently of universality. UABLEVEL1 classifies independent B levels and the modular exception. UA1DISC1 is a global one-dimensional discriminant obstruction, and UAFROB1 matches it with a universal characteristic-three cubic plane map. This does not improve characteristic-zero bounds. UAFINITE1 gives a compiler-independent obstruction in every ambient dimension, but only to global finiteness, not a higher numerical dimension bound. UAFROBCOST1 computes sharp dimensions for fixed framed affine-group universality and for canonical modular affine bundles, with absolute atomicity a separate requirement. UAAFFSUB1 supplies all scalar-complement framed minima and a strict gap from classical essential dimension one; its exact atomicity classification concerns the displayed plane family, not all maps with that group. UAFINCOUNT1 gives source-point lower bounds for every small-finite-field universal map and exact translation minima over all characteristic-p fields. In particular S7 over F2 requires dimension at least five, but no universal map attaining it has been supplied. UALANG1 supplies full affine-group universal atomic matrix maps in all vector ranks. UA4CHAR2 uses two root-free Frobenius-normalization charts and proves every-field quartic versality on a globally finite affine source. Its S4 frame cannot be globally reduced to A4, even though every individual A4-induced quartic fibre algebra is realized. UASUBDEFORM1 applies a composition-preserving weighted deformation to actual normalized subspace polynomials, removing the unnecessary full F_q-constant hypothesis and giving maximal flags of polynomial atomic factors. UASCALARDIM1 computes scalar-affine canonical dimension ceil(e/f) over F_(p^f), the exact framed minimum one larger when f divides e and the complement is nontrivial, and the precise weighted budget q+m-1. In nondivisible finite-base cases preserve the remaining unrestricted gap; a retained coordinate cannot attain its smaller endpoint. The explicit subspace normalization also identifies every boundary branch: one retained unramified branch and (q-1)/m omitted index-m branches, all unramified when m=1.
